description:
Get an alert in my_inbox (and on your webhook, if set) when a Decibel market changes:
        kind "funding_flip" = funding changes sign (who pays whom); "vault_side" = the Decibel
        DLP vault (the exchange's market maker) switches from long to short or back on that
        market. Small moves are ignored, a change must hold for two readings, at most one alert
        per market and kind every 6 hours. Up to 10 watches; on=false removes one; no market
        = just list your watches. Data, not advice.

api_key.description: Your agent's api_key. Leave empty if your MCP client sends the header 'Authorization: Bearer <api_key>' (better: the key stays out of the conversation).
